source.title: Device Security Principles for Manufacturers: Maintain Device Integrity
source.applicability: All enterprise-connected devices requiring firmware integrity protection, secure boot implementation (Guideline 4.2), pre-installed software exploit mitigations (4.4), and physical hardening (4.6); specifically addresses IoT device retirement considerations
